articles.title: Danieli (BIT:DAN) Stock Could Be 38% Undervalued As Cash Flow Holds Up
articles.summary: Danieli & C. Officine Meccaniche has delivered a striking 3 year share price run, and that raises a simple question for you as an investor. Is the current price at €54.15 broadly in line with what the company’s cash flows can support, or has sentiment moved ahead of the underlying money it can generate over time?
